question.problem:
The basis $B$ of ${R}^{3}$ and the matrix $[\,T\,]_{B}$ of the linear transformation $T:{R}^{3}\to {R}^{3}$ relative to $B$ are given by

$$
B=\{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ -3\end{aligned}]\},\,[\,T\,]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}a & 2 & -5 \\ 2 & b & 7 \\ -1 & 0 & c\end{aligned}].
$$

What is the value of $\,a+b+c,\,$ given that  

$$
T({b}_{1})=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,T({b}_{2})=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,T({b}_{3})=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3 \\ 6\end{aligned}].
$$
